name: Pama-Nyungan Family

linguisticChallenges.freeWordOrder: Pama-Nyungan languages are famous for relatively free word order — grammatical relations are encoded by case suffixes rather than position. Pragmatic factors (topic, focus, emphasis) determine word order.
linguisticChallenges.ergativity: Most members use ergative-absolutive case alignment — the subject of a transitive verb takes a special ergative case marker, while both intransitive subjects and transitive objects are unmarked (absolutive). Some show split ergativity conditioned by tense or NP type.

notes: Minimal family card for Pama-Nyungan (~261 members). The largest family of Australian Aboriginal languages, covering most of the Australian continent. Free word order and ergative alignment are the most consistently shared typological features. Many members are critically endangered or extinct.

regions.region: Most of the Australian continent (all except parts of northern Australia)
